conviction_note: Event confirmed for 2026-10-13 and the release lands at about 15:30 JST, so the window runs close to close. The one company-level read is that the property side of Q1 looks smaller than last year's. I counted the company's own sale disclosures: 7 deliveries in June 2026 and none in Jul-Aug, against about 11 projects in Q1 FY26. Anyone can count those disclosures, there is no street bar, and this company has never revised its forecast at Q1, so the release is unlikely to add to it. The finding is therefore sized small, and p_up sits at 47 rather than lower. The two measurements agree in sign: impact_sum -0.70 against a scaled -0.21. The scaled number is smaller because of the name's run of positive estimated reactions and the chance of relief now the bad news is out (悪材料出尽くし). The crowded margin long pulls the other way.
bar: Unsourced street bar: no 四季報/IFIS consensus was reachable (kabuyoho shows no consensus: https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=3236). The bar used is the company FY27/5 plan, OP 3,549m / ordinary 3,135m (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260713592332.pdf), against the company's own Q1 progress history: Q1 FY26 OP 963m = 30% of actual / 50% of original plan, and Q1 FY25 OP 1,233m = 37% of actual (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3236). print_vs_bar compares my rough Q1 OP estimate (~0.8-1.0bn) with a ~30-37% x 3,549 own-history bar. Every size is capped small because of this.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% with no disclosed seller at or above 0.5% (as of 2026-09-29, from the baseline; https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Margin per kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=3236): margin shorts 0.0k shares and margin longs 2,717.6k on 10/02, up from 2,547.2k on 09/11. The name is buy-only under 制度信用, so 信用倍率 is undefined (infinite). The margin long is about 7.7% of 35.1m shares outstanding and about 34 days of median turnover (~¥21.7m/day, roughly 79k shares), and it was building into the print. There is no option skew. Run-up: -3.19% over 20 days and -0.36% over 5; kabutan shows the price 13.7% below its 200-day line.

findings.finding: The company's own sale disclosures show 7 FY27 Q1 deliveries, all in June 2026: Shinjuku 14 units, Hongo 14, Shirakawa 11, Komazawa 27, Ichigayadaimachi 15, a land-only parcel in Kuramae, and one value-up building in Kitazawa. None was disclosed for July or August. Q1 FY26 sold 9 rental-development and 2 value-up projects (rental segment revenue 7,274m, segment profit 1,071m). So the property side of this Q1 is likely well below last year's. The full-year plan of 12 rental + 6 value-up projects comes with an explicitly lower margin. Ogawa Kensetsu's construction quarter (Apr-Jun; FY27 is its first full year consolidated, annual revenue ~27.9bn, OP ~1.6bn) inflates revenue but adds only modest profit. My read: consolidated Q1 OP progress of about 23-30% of the 3,549m plan, against 30-37% of actual in the prior two Q1s.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY26 (released 2025-10-14 15:30): ordinary profit -19% YoY, yet the estimated reaction was +2.55%, which looks like relief now the bad news was out. Q1 FY25 (2024-10-15) estimated reaction -2.78%. Both from the baseline's estimated-cadence history.

findings.why_not_priced: Only partly priced. Each sale was disclosed one at a time with no price, and nobody aggregates them into a Q1 estimate for a ¥9.6bn name with no analyst consensus. Had the read been fully priced, I would expect the margin long to be unwinding instead of building (2.55m to 2.72m shares in September), and the stock would not be flat over 5 days. Against that, the count is public, so this sits in LESSONS rule 1 territory and is sized small.
findings.independence: The forecast table in the FY26 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260713592332.pdf) points the same way: 12 rental + 6 value-up projects for FY27, lower margin, net profit guided -13.9%. Fisco's 2026-08-18 memo (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3236&b=n202608180446) cuts against it: it says the company habitually guides conservatively and its results skew to the first half. It shares the plan document.

findings.finding: Leveraged retail is crowded long into the print: the buy-only 制度信用 margin long is 2,717.6k shares (about 7.7% of shares outstanding, about 34 days of turnover), it rose about 7% over three weeks, and margin shorts are zero. Any disappointment therefore has forced sellers and no short cover to absorb it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed history of margin unwinds on this name. Its last four estimated reactions were all positive (+2.55, +15.16, +2.72, +7.89), so the crowded long has not been punished at prints so far.
findings.why_not_priced: The baseline's lean has no margin component (margin_overhang is null, so priced_lean_pct ignores this), and the JPX short register reads zero, so the overhang is invisible to the lean.

outside_window.finding: Inventory restocking in Aug-Sep 2026: acquisitions at Koenji-minami (rental, 08-19), Botan (rental, 09-18) and Koenji-kita (value-up, 09-25). This supports FY28 and later deliveries, not this print.

baseline_tension: The finding leans mildly negative, roughly in line with the flat-to-negative run-up and the crowded margin long. The strongest positive the release could carry is a buyback (last year's came six days after Q1) or relief that the plan is held (a near certainty given the company's history). I looked for both and found nothing pre-announced. The name's last four estimated reactions were all positive, which is why p_up is only 47.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series anyone can compute, with no forecast cut likely at this release): finding 1 cut from -0.8 to -0.4, and p_up moved from 45 to 47

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): the strongest positives (a buyback, a held plan, positive reaction history) are written into baseline_tension; I had already looked for them, so no further change
Finding 2 (positioning) is untouched by the file and stays at -0.3
